sokkel-egui.note: Unfoldable built before this spec, with forced; not yet compared with it.

sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: A heading that opens what is under it. The whole heading row is the control: the chevron turns, the row says whether it is open, and it washes under the pointer the way a menu row does. A line under the heading can say in short what is folded away while it is shut, facts can stand at the row's end, and a row with nothing to unfold is static, lined up with the rest. Held open while forced, as a filter does while it is typed.

anatomy.unfoldable: The column: the row, then the summary while shut or the content while open, 8 apart.
anatomy.row: The heading row, the whole of it the control while it unfolds (a button): the chevron, then the heading; padded 4 all round and reaching 4 past the column on each side, so its words line up with the text around it.
anatomy.chevron: A chevron pointing at the heading, turned down while open; 14 square, in muted-foreground. While forced it is turned down in faint; a static row keeps its room empty.
anatomy.heading: The heading, text.sm at 500, cut to one line.
anatomy.aside: Facts at the row's end, outside the button's name, such as a count: text.xs in muted-foreground, 8 apart.
anatomy.summary: While shut, a line under the heading saying what the folded part holds in short: text.xs in muted-foreground, under the heading's start (layout.indent), 6 up into the column's gap, one line unless wrapSummary.
anatomy.content: While open, what it holds, under the heading's start (layout.indent).

aside.does: Facts at the row's end, outside the button's name, such as a count.

summary.does: A line under the heading while it is shut, such as what the folded part holds in short.

open.does: Whether it is open, held by the app with onOpenChange; held inside when not given.

onOpenChange.does: Called with the open state the reader asked for.

forced.does: Holds it open whatever the reader chose, as a filter does while it is typed: the row is static meanwhile, its chevron turned down in faint, and the reader's own choice returns when it is let go.

wrapSummary.does: Lets a long summary wrap onto more lines instead of being cut to one.

children.does: What opens under the heading. Without it the row is static: no chevron and no button, its heading where an unfoldable row's stands, so a list of mixed rows lines up.

row.note: A finger tall below md while it unfolds.

indent.note: The summary's and the content's start: the chevron's 14 and the row's 8, so they line up with the heading.

rest.means: Shut: the chevron points at the heading, the summary under it.

hover.means: The pointer is over a row that unfolds.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on the row: the focus ring inside it.

open.means: Open: the chevron turned down, the content under the heading, no summary.
open.reached: a press, Enter or Space on the row; open or defaultOpen

forced.means: Held open: the row is static, its chevron turned down in faint.

rest.note: In the ink of what it stands on.

focus.note: The ring drawn inside the row (ring-inset).

keyboard.when: it unfolds and is not forced

keyboard.does: Opens or shuts what is under the heading.

appText.heading: What the row says.
appText.summary: What the folded part holds, in short.

sokkel-ui: The row is a native button with aria-expanded; a static row (no children, or forced) is a div.
The chevron turns with a CSS transition.

drift.today: As of 1a87987, Unfoldable was built before this spec (with forced) and has not been compared with it.
As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
